messages.finish_built: Your brain is ready: {n} folders, your About pages, your projects and the people you named.
messages.finish_open: Open Phygital Memory and open this folder to browse your notes.
messages.finish_daily: Every day, open a chat on this folder and talk normally, for example "I had a call with Marta, here's what we agreed". Your agent files everything in the right place.
messages.finish_keeper: The Brain Keeper tidies your brain every work day at {keeper time}. Say "check up my brain" anytime.
messages.finish_brief: Your morning brief comes at {brief time} on work days. Say "morning brief" anytime.
messages.finish_phone: Your brain is in your cloud drive, so you can use it from your phone.
messages.finish_instructions: Want your agent to talk like this in every chat, not only in your brain? Copy this into your agent's settings.
messages.finish_old_notes: Want me to bring in your old notes now?
messages.finish_extras: You can also say "prep me for Marta", "challenge my idea" or "undo the last change".
messages.instructions_example: Use simple, plain words and no jargon. Keep replies short, no walls of text. Use short lists and examples. Work step by step and check each step before moving on. Do only what I asked.
messages.keeper_line: Brain Keeper: {n} things need you, see
messages.drive_connect_google: Connect Google Drive: in Claude, open Settings, then Connectors, then Google Drive, and click Connect. Sign in and allow what it asks, then come back here.
messages.drive_connect_other: Connect {drive}: in Claude, open Settings, then Connectors, and look for {drive}. If it isn't there, add its MCP server. Then come back here.
messages.drive_icloud: iCloud has no connector for most agents, so your agent can't reach your brain from your phone. It still syncs to your other Apple devices.
messages.drive_checking: Checking that your agent can see this folder in {drive}…
messages.drive_ok: Connected. Your brain will be on your phone too.
messages.drive_failed: Your agent can't find this folder in {drive} yet. Check that the folder is inside your {drive} folder and that the connector is on. Syncing can take a minute.
messages.drive_later_note: No problem. Your brain works on this computer. Say "connect my cloud drive" anytime to add it.
messages.finish_assistant: It's ready, and from now on I'm your personal assistant. I know your work, your goals and the people around you, and I'll learn more each time we talk. We'll grow together and get better at this.
messages.finish_ask: Ask me anything, anytime: how to use your brain, what it can do, or an idea you'd like to work on.
messages.finish_start: To start, talk to me the way you'd talk to a friend: "I had a call with Marta, here's what we agreed." I'll put it in the right place.
messages.finish_cloud_later: For now, your brain is only on this computer. When you're ready, say "connect my cloud drive" and I'll help you link Google Drive or another drive. Your brain is then backed up, and you can use it from your phone too.
messages.finish_cloud_on: Your brain is in your cloud drive, so it's backed up and on your phone too.
messages.finish_keeper_short: Every work day at {keeper time}, the Brain Keeper tidies your notes for you.
messages.addons_later: You can add these anytime. Just ask "what can I add to my brain?"
messages.phygital_memory_offer: Want to browse your notes like an app? Phygital Memory shows your brain as a notes app on your computer.
messages.phone_drive_needed: Your brain needs a cloud drive to live in, so you can reach it from your phone. Let's connect one.
messages.phone_google_account: No Google account yet? Make a free one at accounts.google.com. It comes with 15 GB of Google Drive.
messages.phone_icloud: iCloud can't be used from your agent on a phone yet. Google Drive is the easiest choice: it's free and works right away.
messages.phone_drive_stop: No problem. When your drive is connected, come back and say "Build my second brain on my phone".

Connect a cloud drive now or later.

forms.Which cloud drive do you use?: Which cloud drive do you use?
Welcome to the Phygital Brain setup.
A second brain that thinks with you.
Phygital Brain is an OS for your notes. I'll build one folder in your cloud drive, with notes about you, your work and your people, and rules I follow every time. From then on, every chat starts already knowing you. Your notes stay yours, as plain files you can take to any AI.
